doc: Design a running application live: its sources and API, edits run at once with their state kept, expectations checked, the person's turn kept as a test, edits written back to the TypeScript sources.

tools.name: design.sources
tools.description: The scripts the application is made of: each one's path, language and the text it runs now (edited, or its file's), and the modules they import

tools.name: design.api
tools.description: How the scripts are written here: each language's API over this application's components — every builder with its properties (types, choices), handlers and actions, and the functions of the module — read before writing an edit

tools.name: design.edit
tools.description: Runs new text as a script, at once, its state kept: the semantic changes it made and how long it took — or its problems, with their lines, and nothing changed. The edit stays until design.commit writes it to the file or design.discard drops it
tools.undo: design.edit with the text before, or design.discard

path.description: a script or a module it imports, as design.sources names it

tools.name: design.expect
tools.description: What the person expects, kept to check against: `say` in their words, `query` the nodes it means (id, role, name, state, value …), `absent` when they must not be there; with no query, lists what is expected

say.description: the expectation in the person's words

tools.name: design.check
tools.description: Each expectation read against the interface as it is now: holds or not, the nodes found with their name, value and states, and for a node that did not do what was expected, what the last press on it came to (the recorder)

tools.name: design.handover
tools.description: Hands the floor to the person: they try the design; what they do from now, done, can be saved as a scenario (design.save_scenario)

tools.name: design.save_scenario
tools.description: What the person did since design.handover — their actions that were done, as semantic steps (node, action, arguments) — and what is expected, written as tests/<name>.scenario.omui.json beside the application: a demonstration as a test

tools.name: design.replay
tools.description: A saved scenario played again: each step done as it was, then what is expected checked — the demonstration as a test
tools.undo: the steps' own (ui.undo for reversible ones)

tools.name: design.discard
tools.description: Drops every edit not committed: each edited script runs its file's text again; the dropped texts are answered
tools.undo: design.edit with each text it answered

tools.name: design.commit
tools.description: Writes every edit to its script's file (TypeScript stays the one source); each file's text before is answered
tools.undo: design.edit with each text before, then design.commit
